comments.author: davesmith1983
comments.story: A New Motherboard for Amiga, the Platform That Refuses to Die
comments.why: Complete rundown of the Apollo Vampire V2 accelerator.
comments.text: A1200 boards are over 25 years old. A lot of the boards are damaged because of capacitors leaking, just being old. Many of us that still use the Amigas like using "proper hardware". I like the idea of taking a 25 year old computer and hacking the machine to play DOOM or going on IRC or even checking my emails. FPGAs have been used for Amiga Accelerators the fastest accelerator (at present) is the Apollo Vampire V2. Here is a complete rundown of the accelerator: [VIDEO]
